parentTasks.title: 流体領域を作り、流れを解析

parentTasks.acceptance: 単純参照形状から粗い牛型へ進み、版・配布条件・壁/遠方境界・メッシュ・停止・入出力契約を固定。速度・圧力・抗力・質量収支と領域/メッシュ/時間依存性を検証する。Stokes設定変更や未検証の層流仮定で代替せず、公開経路を待たせない。 2026-10-16: SU2 任意経路(取得は明示実行・固定SHA-256、同梱しない、LGPL-2.1表示)をmainへ反映(PR7)。実験的で上記の未達は変わらない。
parentTasks.titleEn: Create fluid regions and simulate flow
parentTasks.detailEn: Started ordinary-speed external flow. Cow 3D steady SA RANS ran directly and in a separate process from the real Studio browser API; pressure/velocity arrays and output hashes match. Experimental fixed-case connection/view only: wall treatment fails at 116 points, velocity/turbulence targets are unmet, boundary-layer/accuracy and shared-job/MCP integration remain pending. Seven compute/data tools are available through native-only MCP or optional full-MCP startup. Real MCP cow rerun/pages match direct execution with warnings/cancellation/release verified; native view MCP remains pending.
parentTasks.acceptanceEn: Progress from simple references to rough cow geometry, fixing version/distribution, wall/far-field boundaries, mesh, cancellation and I/O contracts. Verify velocity, pressure, drag, mass balance and domain/mesh/time dependence. Do not substitute Stokes settings or unverified laminar assumptions; do not delay publication work. 2026-10-16: The opt-in SU2 path (explicit download with a pinned SHA-256, not bundled, LGPL-2.1 notice) is merged (PR 7). Experimental; the open items above are unchanged.

parentTasks.lastUpdateEn: 2026-10-22: Reject missing required velocity/turbulence residual columns. Fine mesh completed once in89.078s under a240s budget with previous config.
